name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: A month grid of 32px day keys: today in blue, a chosen day as the blue key, a range on the blue tint.
usage: Pick a day, several days or a range in place (a report window, the days a monitor runs). For a field that opens a calendar use DatePicker. Use mode="single" (the default), "multiple" or "range"; disabled takes dates, ranges or a function. Arrow keys, Page Up and Page Down work.
avoid: Weekday names longer than two letters
A calendar without a way to reach today

reference.source: Extrapolated from context-dashboard c0ddf7a src/components/ui/button.tsx (ghost icon buttons, the wash and the brand blue) with dates as in src/lib/format-date.ts
reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
